title: Kid Sheik
summary: He played yard parties and Manny's with Kid Sheik, but not at El Morocco.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: What about Kid Sheik? Did you ever play with him?
Yeah, I played a couple of jobs at Sheik. What was that?
Oh, that was little yard parties.
Oh, you know, down there in the Night Ward, played a couple of yard parties with him. In the 20s or recently or what? No, that was around the 40s.
Mm-hmm. But he wouldn't be at Manny's or anywhere like that with Joe or whatever, huh? Probably El Moraco, any place?
Yeah, he played at Manny's. Mm-hmm. But I don't remember, no, he never played at El Moraco with us. We played at Manny's.
And several other little spot jobs he played with us. Mm-hmm.
